When is my bus arriving? How to get to the airport? Where the tram that I see is going? Where to go on a transfer? Easy Transit app answers any questions of "here and now" type, instead of swamping you with complex lists and tables.

— See live updated arrival times for the nearest bus stop.
— Go to any place from a search or choose on a map.
— Save often-visited places to bookmarks, to plan a route with a single touch.
— Pin your trip plan to consult it at transfers.
— No ads, no purchases, no data collected.

This app uses the official Tallinn public transport API to get stop arrivals: the same one used for displays at stops, but for any stop. Enhanced with OpenTripPlanner API on the official GTFS feed. It makes possible for planning trips even in Harjumaa, as well as stop timetables there. Searching is done with Photon geocoder: not as good as commercial options, but good enough, and free.

Internet connection is required, otherwise the app will have no information to display. It uses just kilobytes of traffic, unlike most transit apps. Geolocation is strongly recommended, unless you like to scroll a map — a lot.

GeliosMobile is a mobile app developed for users of Gelios tracking system, which allows real-time tracking of units, as well as getting information on their movement in a graphical view on the map. GeliosMobile allows you to generate reports, get statistics on quality of driving, receive notifications about various events, build tracks, send commands and much more.

This is mobile client of GPS-server tracking application. In order to use this application, you must have personal account or hosted software.

GPS-server.net features:
- Real time tracking mode represents live data of tracked objects. Information is updated every ten seconds without need to refresh page or relogin to account. Monitored data contains vehicle status, latitude, longitude, altitude, address, speed, connection time, ignition status, fuel consumption, sensor data, nearest geozone and much more.

- Widgets display recent object information which is updated every ten seconds without need to refresh web page. Send commands to control device, view recent events and mileage graph.

- Events is one of the most important feature which our software offers. Events are used to trigger actions by important or disruptive activities. Customer will get instant SMS/E-mail/Push notifications triggered by different event types.

- History shows all stored data which server has collected from connected devices for chosen period of time.
